Initial release of "roundtable" discussion mode—a structured, multi-role deep-dive dialogue for truth-seeking.

- Activates when user inputs "圆桌", "圆桌讨论", "roundtable", or similar keywords.
- Host guides the discussion as a rational moderator, inviting 3-4 ideologically distinct figures with MBTI types for each.
- Dialog proceeds in structured rounds: topic definition, viewpoint sharing, ASCII framework visualization, and dynamic questioning.
- Markdown formatting ensures clarity; users can control discussion flow with commands.
